aboutDrawData

Draw-timing plan for the two bio columns. Both columns share ONE 1500ms animation budget: charDelay = 1500ms ÷ totalChars (both columns), and each paragraph's offset = cumulative chars before it × delay — so col2's first paragraph starts exactly when col1's last ends. The bio reads as a single continuous type-in flowing down the left column then continuing down the right.
